principles: Receipt-backed Authority claims must be mechanically verified, not inferred from local DONE or prose.
Host-neutral layering must remain explicit: CLI Non-authority evidence and Authority Server proof are separate results.
The audit should prefer the narrowest executable path and record blockers rather than broadening Authority architecture.
Secrets and credentials must be consumed only through configured paths and never printed or committed.
drivers: User explicitly wants true Authority Server receipt-backed proof for B-12f3.
Current status loads trust env only when explicitly pointed at the root secret file from the worktree.
Configured trust env still lacks actor key and runner id, and no gate_decision receipt is currently verified.

options.name: A: Attempt real Authority path, then fail closed on missing prerequisites
pros: Directly tries the user-requested receipt-backed path
Preserves Authority boundary if actor/runner/receipt are missing
Produces actionable evidence without rewriting B-12f3 history
cons: May end blocked if server prerequisites are not available in this environment

options.name: B: Treat B-12f3 local DONE as sufficient
pros: Fast and already has local lifecycle artifacts
cons: Incorrectly conflates Non-authority local evidence with Authority Server proof
Would overclaim authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone without receipt-backed proof

options.name: C: Implement new Authority credential/provisioning framework now
pros: Could eventually make future Authority runs smoother
cons: Arbitrary broad optimization beyond this audit
High blast radius and not required to answer whether B-12f3 has verified proof today

chosen: A: Attempt real Authority path, then fail closed on missing prerequisites
rationale: Choose the only path that can satisfy the user request when real Authority prerequisites exist while remaining correct and fail-closed when they do not.

preMortem.scenario: Trust env is not loaded from the story worktree
preMortem.trigger: authority_trust.env is gitignored in the main root and absent from the worktree
preMortem.consequence: CLI falls back to localhost default and misdiagnoses server readiness
preMortem.mitigation: Use LATTICE_AUTHORITY_TRUST_ENV_FILE pointing at the root secret file; record status fields without printing secrets

preMortem.trigger: actor key, runner id, session, job, or gate_decision receipt is missing
preMortem.consequence: No true Authority proof can be produced
preMortem.mitigation: Record blocked_classified evidence with authorityDone=false/fullAuthorityDone=false and exact missing prerequisites

preMortem.scenario: Local DONE is accidentally overclaimed as Authority DONE
preMortem.trigger: Summary or checklist wording says receiptVerified/authorityDone without verified receipt
preMortem.mitigation: Require receipt id plus authority_receipt_verify or job_status receipt-backed output before any Authority completion claim

preMortem.scenario: Secrets leak into logs or commits
preMortem.trigger: Printing authority_trust.env or committing copied secret files
preMortem.mitigation: Never cat the trust file; use status redacted fields only; keep authority_trust.env ignored and uncommitted
